message: So there I was, cooking dinner, and my phone decided to go on strike—battery dead right when I was trying to look up a recipe. 😅 It got me thinking about how much we rely on our devices, especially during emergencies. I remembered how important it is to have a solid fire escape plan and working smoke alarms, just in case things go sideways. It’s always good to have those basics in place, you know? What’s your go-to kitchen safety tip?
